data.title: mimo-v2.6 RL
data.subtitle: Two reinforcement-learning runs, mimo-v2.6-pro and mimo-v2.6-flash, read directly from the trainer's logs.

descriptions.dynsam/avg@n: mean pass rate: for each prompt sampled this step, the fraction of its n attempts that succeed, averaged over prompts
descriptions.dynsam/avg@n_no_infra: avg@n with attempts that failed for infrastructure reasons excluded
descriptions.critic/rewards/mean: mean reward over trajectories trained on this step
descriptions.actor/entropy_loss: mean per-token entropy of the policy
descriptions.train_infer_diff/new_infer/kl: KL between inference-engine and trainer log-probs on the same tokens
descriptions.dynsam/passrate/zero: share of prompts where no attempt succeeded
descriptions.dynsam/passrate/one: share of prompts where every attempt succeeded
descriptions.dynsam/infra_error/seq_rate: share of sequences lost to infrastructure failures
descriptions.partial/avg_staleness: policy versions between sampling and training, on average
descriptions.dynsam/num_measurable: prompts with a measurable pass rate this step; per data source under dynsam/<source>/num_measurable
descriptions.dynsam/passrate/hist9_ratio: share of prompts by pass rate, in nine bins from none solved to all solved
descriptions.train/harness/*/training/rollouts: rollouts in the training batch, per agent harness
descriptions.ctx_total_length/mean: total context length per trajectory (prompt + response), in tokens
